// NEGATIVE fixture — `.findLast(` / `.findLastIndex(` only where a lexer must not see it.
// A line comment: list.findLast(pred)
/* A block comment: list.findLastIndex(pred) */
const SINGLE = 'list.findLast(pred)';
const DOUBLE = "list.findLastIndex(pred)";
const TEMPLATE = `scan backwards by hand, never list.findLast(pred)`;
const IN_REGEX = /\.findLast(Index)?\s*\(/;

export function mentionsFindLast(source) {
  return /\.findLast(Index)?\s*\(/.test(source);
}

export function newest(list, pred) {
  // Near-miss in real code: `.findLastSeen(` is neither `.findLast(` nor `.findLastIndex(`.
  if (list.findLastSeen) return list.findLastSeen();
  for (let i = list.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
    if (pred(list[i])) return list[i];
  }
  return null;
}

export { SINGLE, DOUBLE, TEMPLATE, IN_REGEX };
